# Character realism audit — 2026-10-21

Scope: improve the visible football characters, preserve measured height/weight, keep related fictional people consistent, and verify the candidate before deployment. This is a fresh audit of the current worktree. Existing S117 work remains partial; historical checks do not certify this candidate.

## Findings and selected outcomes

| Rank | Tier | Category | Finding and implementation | Effort | Impact | Innovation | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | P0 | UI / immersion | The actual dossier's torso is a flat-looking cylinder, with a broad straight shoulder line and abrupt sleeve boundaries. Refine the measured envelope with anatomical front/back relief, a shaped collar and cloth shading; retain saved landmarks and motion articulation. | 4h | 9 | 6 | Inspect before/after desktop/mobile dark/light, front/profile and six motions; finite mesh and measurement regression checks. |
| 2 | P0 | Features / identity | `createPlayerIdentity` samples each person independently and has no family authority. Add explicit family inheritance, shared category and heritage, individually varied faces and a persistent shared pigmentation anchor. Never infer kinship from surnames. | 3h | 9 | 5 | Related generation shares background and resembles its anchor; unrelated generation unchanged; save restoration stable; ratings independent. |
| 3 | P0 | Quality / release | Current visual receipt explicitly retains one craft defect; core/runtime acceptance is stale/nonpassing. Verify the current complete candidate, fix regressions at source, deploy staging and inspect the exact artifact before production. | 4h | 10 | 3 | Current suite and browser evidence; hash-bound visual receipt; staging and production readback with rollback. |

## Nine-axis assessment

Features/depth: family authority is absent. UI/UX: real screenshot confirms simplified torso and material transitions. Feedback: existing motion selector and measurement guides provide usable feedback. Engagement/immersion: individualized characters can strengthen attachment to roster decisions. Intelligence: deterministic local generation fits this offline game; external AI calls are unnecessary. Security: new identity input requires validation before mutation. Speed/organization: reuse the current cached body rig and renderer; avoid runtime mesh rebuilds. Token/cost: static procedural rendering adds no hosted inference cost. Competitive context: no new market claims made; this audit is bounded to the requested character work.

## Game-loop review

Loop tightness: roster → dossier → development decisions already connects character inspection to management. Progression: measured body and saved identity must remain stable across seasons and restoration. Session engagement: six movement studies exist and their browser test passes 3/3 on the baseline. Retention: family resemblance can make careers recognizable. Soul fidelity: preserve the static browser franchise simulator and fictional-player identity. Next actions are the three selected outcomes above; no unrelated game-economy expansion is selected.

## Execution log

- Baseline: actual dossier browser tests passed 3/3. Inspected `output/playwright/character-final-desktop-dark-run.png`; torso and sleeve contour defects confirmed.
- Implementation and release acceptance pending.
- Current progress: explicit family authority reaches real draft cohorts and the actual dossier. Shared category, heritage and pigment anchors persist; faces remain individual. Import conflicts and stale retired-anchor chronology found in independent review are fixed. No football RNG or physical/gameplay attributes change when family links are added.
- Current production geometry adds measured torso relief, garment collar/panels and swing-foot articulation with contact/floor limits. All six movement modes retain the cached character model.
- Checks: 23 focused tests pass; current character browser tests 3/3 and family dossier browser test 1/1 pass; Pages build passes. `docs/visual-qa/CHARACTER_PROGRESS_2026-10-21.json` binds 64 before/after captures and 14 source files; only five listed images have been visually inspected so far. Full visual acceptance remains false.
- Broader core run remains live and diagnostic because later source edits occurred after it started. It must not be used as exact-candidate release proof.
